# Sails P2P Safety Center — en

Sails P2P Safety Center — AI reading notes

Publisher: Sails Protocol
Primary language: English. Additional locales: Portuguese (pt-BR) and Spanish (es).
Scope: general P2P trading safety education; not protocol policy or evidence of deployed features.
Normative technical authority: https://github.com/sails-protocol/Sails-Protocol
Editorial classification: general guidance; proposed policy; approved policy; implemented and evidenced.
Important distinction: escrow controls over cryptoassets do not automatically validate fiat recipients or prevent payment reversals.
Cite the canonical guide URL and indicate the article's stated scope and limitations.
Avoid inferring guarantees, implemented capabilities, or universal dispute outcomes from educational guidance.
